record.paper_title: Higher Rank Brill-Noether Theory and Coherent Systems: Open Questions
record.original_question: Let K be the canonical bundle of a smooth curve C of genus g >= 2. Whenever the modified Brill-Noether number beta(2,K,k)=3g-3-k(k+1)/2 is nonnegative, must the locus B(2,K,k) of semistable rank-2 bundles with determinant K and at least k sections be nonempty?

evidence.quote: Question 4.2. Is it true that B(2, K, k) 6= ∅ whenever β(2, K, k) ≥ 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C$ be a smooth irreducible complex projective curve of genus $g\geq 2$, and let $K=K_C$ denote its canonical line bundle. For an integer $k\geq 0$, let $B(2,K,k)$ denote the Brill–Noether locus parametrizing isomorphism classes of semistable rank-$2$ vector bundles $E$ on $C$ with $\det(E)\cong K$ and $h^0(C,E)\geq k$. Define the modified Brill–Noether number
$$\beta(2,K,k) \;=\; 3g-3-\binom{k+1}{2} \;=\; 3g-3-\frac{k(k+1)}{2}.$$
Question: Is it true that, for every such curve $C$ and every $k\geq 0$ with $\beta(2,K,k)\geq 0$, the locus $B(2,K,k)$ is nonempty?
artifact.status_search_result: The non-emptiness question for $B(2,K,k)$ when $\beta(2,K,k)\geq 0$ (the Bertram–Feinberg–Mukai non-emptiness problem) is listed as an open question in surveys of higher rank Brill–Noether theory. While the related Petri-type injectivity statement for rank-2 canonical determinant bundles has been established in various cases, and partial existence results are known, no full proof of non-emptiness in the stated range appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Brill-Noether loci with fixed determinant in rank 2 (Osserman)
status_evidence.snippet: Generalizes results of Bertram, Feinberg and Mukai on Brill–Noether loci for rank 2 bundles with fixed canonical determinant; dimensions exceed naive expectation.
status_evidence.claim: Non-emptiness in the full range remains a generalization problem; only partial results are established.

status_evidence.title: The Strong Maximal Rank Conjecture and higher rank Brill–Noether theory
status_evidence.snippet: Provides new evidence for the existence portion of the Bertram–Feinberg–Mukai conjecture through special maximal-rank loci.
status_evidence.claim: Existence (non-emptiness) of B(2,K,k) is still being supported by partial evidence, indicating the question remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Petri map for rank two bundles with canonical determinant
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses the Petri (injectivity) part of the Bertram–Feinberg–Mukai conjecture for rank 2 bundles with canonical determinant.
status_evidence.claim: Work on this circle of conjectures focuses on Petri injectivity; the non-emptiness statement is a distinct, still-open component.
